head.text: 10DLC Readiness Checker: Will Your Campaign Pass?

attrs.content: Free 22-point 10DLC readiness check. Answer yes or no on your brand record, website, privacy policy, opt-in evidence and sample messages and see what would get your campaign rejected before you submit.
